task.title: Inspect setting details
task.shortdesc: Select a setting and inspect its value, source, validation, schema support, and product location.

prereq.p: Open All settings and select a setting row from Review, Configured, Catalog, search, or a deep link.

context.p: The detail panel is the safe place to understand a single setting before editing it. It shows value shape, source attribution, validation issues, and navigation context.

step.cmd: Select the setting row you need to understand.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Read the current value, source badge, validation messages, and schema/channel support.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Check the product location or related surface link if the setting is also covered elsewhere.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Decide whether to edit, remove, reset, or leave the value unchanged.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: You understand what the setting does in this profile and what action is safe next.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the value shape is unclear, compare with JSON editor or leave the setting unchanged until validation guidance is available.
